items.stem: Complete the statement: A special order should normally be accepted, on financial grounds, if …
options: it is from a new customer
the price is above full cost only
the price is above the variable (marginal) cost and there is spare capacity
items.answer: the price is above the variable (marginal) cost and there is spare capacity
items.markingKey: the price is above the variable (marginal) cost and there is spare capacity. Positive contribution [1]

items.stem: Explain why a business might accept an order at a price below its full cost.
items.answer: If there is spare capacity, fixed costs are already covered; any price above variable cost adds contribution and increases profit.
items.markingKey: Spare capacity/fixed costs unchanged [1]; positive contribution [1] [2]

items.stem: Explain two non-financial factors to consider before accepting a special order.
items.answer: Effect on regular customers and prices; whether it leads to future orders; strain on staff and quality; customer reliability.
items.markingKey: Two factors [1 each] [2]
